site.name: AI Engineering Atlas
site.tagline: A gap-driven roadmap for software engineers learning modern AI engineering.
site.method: You do not need to study every topic. Diagnose first, learn the smallest meaningful gap, produce evidence, and revisit important skills in larger systems.
